# Early user use case

Use this discussion if you are trying AIProfitHub SDK and want help deciding what to track.

## What are you building?

Example: AI SaaS, support bot, document workflow, internal agent, chatbot agency, developer tool.

## Which providers or frameworks are you using?

Example: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, Mistral, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, custom wrapper.

## What cost attribution do you need?

Example: customerId, userId, teamId, feature, route, provider, model, plan, fallbackReason.

## What is painful today?

Example: surprise bill, no per-customer margin, no feature-level cost, output tokens growing, expensive fallback route.

## Do you want help with an AI Spend Audit?

- [ ] Yes, I may want an audit
- [ ] Not yet, just testing the SDK
- [ ] I want dashboard / alerts / optimizer later
